definition: The drawing set for the plan on the bench: its solved plan, elevations, section, bearing lines and roof plan, and a model in the round, all drawn from the same record. A sheet that cannot be drawn honestly says why instead.
basis: Editorial. docs/workbench.md: the drawings are "plan · elevation · section · bearing · roof, generated by the build/ pipeline", the model is "the constructed-3D record for the Round", and "A plate that refuses is NAMED in" the response, never dropped. VISION.md: "Nothing is drawn that is not in the record, so the drawing and the data cannot disagree."

surface.what: Every sheet of the house on the bench, and the house in the round.
read: Each sheet is drawn from the record, never traced: nothing appears that the record does not hold.
Choose a face to see each elevation; the caption says which face is the front.
The model can be turned, cut and taken apart, and its named views lay the flat sheets over it.
A sheet that cannot be drawn names why rather than showing a wrong house.
